payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Riley planning proposal: to avoid self-overlap and maximize soft overlaps, I suggest this tentative chain for my meetings: m010 Friends[0,2)=attend [0,2); m006 Study[1,5)=attend [2,4) or [1,4) if others do; m001 Swim[4,6)=attend [4,5); m009 Lunch[5,8)=attend [5,7); m012 Gaming[7,10)=attend [7,9); m013 Volleyball[8,12)=likely skip or maybe [10,12) only if not doing m011; m011 Study[10,14)=attend [10,12); m014 strict supervisor[12,13)=must attend full [12,13); m004 Lunch[11,13)=skip because conflicts with strict; likely skip overlapping alternatives m008/m002/m005/m007 around 5-11 unless strong group preference forms. If others can align around Gaming [7,9], Study [10,12], and strict [12,13], that seems clean for me.

Quinn tentative planning: to avoid self-overlap, I'm leaning toward a mostly sequential schedule with strong overlap points: m010 Friends [0,2); one of m003 art [2,4) or m006 study [2,4) (slight preference m003 if Jordan aligns); then m015 study [4,5) or m001 swim [4,5); then one of m009 lunch [5,7) / m008 gym [5,7); then m012 gaming [7,10) seems attractive; then m011 study [10,12); m014 strict supervisor full [12,13). I will likely skip overlapping alternatives in the same windows unless a strong consensus forms. If others want alignment, gaming [7,10], study [10,12], and strict [12,13) look like good anchors.

Jordan tentative planning: to avoid self-overlap, I currently favor a sequential path of m010 Friends [0,2), m003 art [2,4), m015 study [4,5), one of m008 gym [5,7) or m009 lunch [5,7) depending group interest, then m012 gaming [7,10), m011 study [10,12), and m014 strict full [12,13). Likely skipping overlapping alternatives m016/m007/m013 and probably m004 due to conflict with strict. If others want alignment, m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), and m014 [12,13) are my strongest anchors. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese tentative plan to maximize overlap while staying conflict-free: strong anchors for me are m010 Friends [0,2), m003 Art [2,4) with Jordan/Quinn/Avery, m001 Swim [4,5) or m015 Study [4,5) (prefer whichever gets more coordination), then one of m009 Lunch [5,7) / m008 Gym [5,7) / m016 Gym [5,7) depending consensus, then m012 Gaming [7,10) looks best, then m011 Study [10,12), and m014 strict supervisor full [12,13). I will likely skip overlapping alternatives m005/m002/m007/m013 and probably m004 due to conflict with strict unless group strongly prefers otherwise. If others can align, my preferred overlap anchors are m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13). For 4-7, please signal preference among m001 swim, m015 study, m009 lunch, m008/m016 gym.

Taylor tentative plan: align on strong common soft anchors while staying conflict-free. For my meetings I currently favor m010 Friends [0,2), m006 Study [2,4) (or [1,4) if others want earlier), then at 4-5 I can do either m001 Swim [4,5) or m015 Study [4,5) depending consensus; for 5-7 I can do one of m009 Lunch [5,7), m008 Gym [5,7), or m016 Gym [5,7) depending group preference; m012 Gaming [7,10) looks like my strongest anchor; then likely m011 Study [10,11) or [10,12). I probably skip m013 Volleyball unless we choose it instead of late study, and m004 lunch [11,13) conflicts with m011 if I do that. Given others' messages, I can align well on m010 [0,2), m012 [7,10), and likely m011 [10,12) if enough people choose it. Please signal preference for 4-7 among m001/m015 and m009/m008/m016, and whether people want m011 [10,12) versus m013/m004 later. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery tentative plan: I can align on the common anchors and avoid conflicts. Current preference for my meetings is m010 Friends [0,2), m003 Art [2,4), m001 Swim [4,5), then m009 Lunch [5,7) rather than m008 gym, then m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), and m014 strict supervisor full [12,13). That means likely skipping overlapping alternatives m006, m005, m007, m008, m013, and probably m004 due to conflict with m014. If others agree, my strongest overlap anchors are m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13), with a mild preference for m001 [4,5) and m009 [5,7] in the middle.

Riley update after seeing others: I can align with the emerging common anchors. For my meetings, I now favor m010 Friends [0,2), m006 Study [2,4), m001 Swim [4,5), m009 Lunch [5,7), m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), and m014 strict supervisor full [12,13). I would then skip overlapping alternatives m008, m002, m005, m007, m013, and probably m004. This matches Avery/Taylor on m001+m009 and everyone on m010/m012/m011/m014. If anyone strongly prefers gym over lunch at 5-7 or wants a different 4-5 anchor, please reply, but lunch [5,7) seems a good coordination point for me.

Quinn update: I’m ready to align on the emerging conflict-free common path for my meetings: m010 Friends [0,2), m003 Art [2,4), m015 Study [4,5), m009 Lunch [5,7), m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), and m014 strict full [12,13). This matches Jordan on the shared early/late anchors and also seems consistent with Avery/Riley/Taylor preferences in the middle. Unless there is strong objection, I will likely skip overlapping alternatives m006, m001, m016, m008, m002, m005, m007, m013, and m004.

Jordan update: I’m ready to align with the emerging common conflict-free path for my meetings: m010 Friends [0,2), m003 Art [2,4), m015 Study [4,5), m009 Lunch [5,7), m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), and m014 strict full [12,13). I’ll likely skip overlapping alternatives m008, m016, m007, m013, and m004. This matches Quinn/Reese and the apparent broader consensus around lunch over gym at 5-7. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese update: I’m happy to align with the apparent consensus path for my meetings: m010 Friends [0,2), m003 Art [2,4), then for 4-5 I can do either m001 Swim [4,5) with Avery/Riley/Taylor or m015 Study [4,5) with Quinn/Jordan/Taylor. Since both give similar overlap and lunch/gaming/study/strict later are the stronger anchors, I’m fine choosing whichever helps group consistency most; slight lean to m009 Lunch [5,7) over gym at 5-7, plus m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12), and m014 strict full [12,13). Unless someone objects, I’ll likely do m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), m001 [4,5), m009 [5,7), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13), and skip my overlapping alternatives.

Taylor update: I’m ready to align with the emerging conflict-free consensus on my meetings. Planned path: m010 Friends [0,2), m006 Study [2,4), m001 Swim [4,5), m009 Lunch [5,7), m012 Gaming [7,10), m011 Study [10,12). I’ll likely skip overlapping alternatives m015, m016, m008, m002, m013, and m004. This matches Riley/Avery/Reese on m001 and broad consensus on m009, m012, m011. Unless objections arise, I’ll use these as my execution intervals. (phase=planning, iter=1)

I expect to skip overlapping alternatives m006, m005, m007, m008, m013, and m004. This should give strong overlap on the major anchors while staying conflict-free.

I’ll skip m015, m016, m008, m002, m013, and m004 unless late changes arise. This keeps me conflict-free and aligns with Riley/Avery/Reese on m001 and broad consensus on m009/m012/m011. Key coalition opportunities with Jordan are m010, m003, m015, m008/m009, m012, m011, m014, m004. Prefer non-overlapping chain; happy to adapt if you have stronger preferences.

Jordan coalition reply: I support a clean non-overlapping chain with us aligned on shared meetings.
